includes: Beers brewed on-site, local spirits, local wines, local meats, and pizza dough made daily
blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed on-site along with a menu featuring appetizers, salads, handmade artisan specialty pizzas with various crust options, sandwiches, and desserts. The pizzeria offers gluten-free cauliflower crust and vegan options upon request. Outdoor seating with mountain views is available and the venue is family- and pet-friendly.
extraNote: Reservations accepted for small groups (1-15) and large parties via form; no reservations on Fridays and Saturdays but call ahead recommended · Outdoor seating is dog-friendly with well-behaved, leashed dogs allowed
